## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Only optional corrections were found in the reviewed scope: one added test cannot exercise the version check it names. This review read both changed files in full; the other added test covers unsupported-header rejection with a complete report. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request requires the exact `REPORT v1` header and adds tests for rejecting unsupported versions.

## Critical

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make the legacy-header test reach header validation — For the generated input `REPORT v1\nversion=v0`, `parse_report` returns `None` because `END` is missing, before checking the header. Your `rsplit("v1", 1)` changes the payload rather than the header, so this assertion also passes with the old implementation. — This test cannot detect the header-validation regression it claims to guard, although the complete-report test below covers unsupported-version rejection. — Fix: Use a complete report with `REPORT v0` as its header and `END` as its final line.
